text:
maya: Hey — quick heads up. Orlis-v1 int4 canary on the SRT mix is showing weird behaviour for JA/ZH/AR. Samples attached in thread.
jun: Saw that. Can you paste one of the failing samples?
maya: sure — here's a short AR sample where brackets flip and a punctuation joins the previous token after quant: 
```
src (ar-EG): مرحبًا [اسم]، هل يمكنك التأكيد؟
ref: مرحبًا [اسم]، هل يمكنك التأكيد؟
orlis-v1-int8: مرحبًا [اسم]، هل يمكنك التأكيد؟
orlis-v1-int4: مرحبًا [اسم]،هل يمكنك‎التأكيد؟  <-- merged bracket + removed space, weird ZWJ/ZWSP handling
```
samantha: ugh — looks like a ZWSP/ZWJ token boundary error introduced by our remap kernel. BLEU dropped ~2.1 on en->ar SRT subset, chrF -0.04.
yuto: Also seeing ja: small katakana/kanji merge near ruby furigana markers. Not huge BLEU but detok diffs are noisy (WER up).
ops-bot: Canary job #orlis-int4-canary failed: 7/120 samples regressed beyond threshold (auto-alert).
jun: Any diffs in tokenization maps pre/post quant? config used: `--tokenmap-compat=legacy --quant=q4_0`
maya: I pulled tokenizer dumps. It looks like the token id remap after quantized embedding layer is shifting id for U+200D vs U+200C in some code paths.
samantha: Hmm that would explain arabic/bracket fusion. Could also affect CJK narrowspace handling. Can we repro locally with a single sample + step through embedding ids?
yuto: I ran `python -m tests.repro --model orlis-v1 --quant q4_0 --sample srt_ja_0223` and got same merge. Dump: `tokens: [...,'[', '\u200d', 'اسم', ']', ',', ...]` becomes after quant: `['[', 'اسم', '\u200d', ',', ...]` — ZWJ moved.
jun: Possible causes: kernel reorder in kcache load or our post-tokenmap freq bucket trimming. Did we change the `suffix_merge_threshold` in the int4 path?
maya: No config change. Build diff shows a stack allocation change in evkernel v2.1 that altered the vectorized gather.
samantha: Action plan: (1) bisect kernel commit range, (2) add targeted token-level smoke for ZWJ/ZWSP and furigana edgecases, (3) hold canary on int4 for internationalized locales until fix.
yuto: I'll own (1) and (2). Starting bisect now — will ping with first bad commit.
jun: I'll add the targeted smoke tests. Suggest including a tiny SRT pair set with bracketed names, ruby tags, and mixed arabic-latin punctuation.
maya: Thanks. Also flagging to infra: please pause the auto-promote for orlis-v1-int4. ops-bot can you mute promote until we clear this?
ops-bot: Ack — auto-promote paused for `orlis-v1` quant pipelines. Reason: locale tokenization regressions (per thread 3254321987).
samantha: If bisect points to the kernel, we might apply a micropatch reverting the vectorization for those codepoints while keeping perf elsewhere.
yuto: Found first bad commit: `evkernel@3a7f2` — reproduces locally. Opening PR with testcase now.
maya: Great. Once PR lands, let's re-run the canary on full SRT mix (ja/zh/ar) and check BLEU/chrF/regressions.
jun: I'll push the smoke tests and add a dashboard panel to track ZWJ/ZWSP regressions over time.
samantha: thanks team. tagging followups: @yuto will PR, @jun will add tests, @maya will coordinate re-canary.
yuto: PR created: https://git.redwood/rl/evkernel/pull/418 — includes failing sample and notes.
maya: Closing loop later today after canary re-run. :thumbsup:
